title: Sum of Squares
statement: Write a function `sumSquares(n)` that returns the sum of the squares of whole numbers from 1 to n (1*1 + 2*2 + ... + n*n). Use a `for` loop.
prewrittenHints: The square of a number is found by multiplying it by itself.
Add the squared value of the current number to your running total.
Count through each number and yield the accumulated sum.
conceptNote: You can perform calculations on the counter variable before adding it.
